newsitem.title: FRANCE: French broker drops Seita from buy list.
newsitem.headline: French broker drops Seita from buy list.

text.p: French brokerage Dupont Denant said on Monday it had dropped tobacco firm Seita from its recommended list, on a view that U.S. President Bill Clinton's decision to act against teenage smoking could provoke U.S. funds into pulling out of the tobacco sector.
"We are not changing our opinion on the fundamentals of the stock, which are good, but it could be dangerous to keep it on our list of recommended shares," analyst Carole Imbert told Reuters.
Seita shares were down 0.5 francs at 208, or 0.24 percent, at 1106 GMT, while the wider market was up 0.05 percent.
Clinton announced last Friday strict rules on the control of tobacco sales and advertising.
